During the quarter ended September 30, 2026; the Nomination and Remuneration Committee (“NRC”) of the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 07, 2026, approved the forfeiture of 32,000 ESOPs granted earlier, thereafter vide circular resolution passed by it on June 07, 2026, approved a further grant of 1,30,367 ESOPs to the eligible employees of the Company and its subsidiary company. Subsequently, the approval in respect of 5,500 ESOPs out of the aforementioned grant was partially superseded by the NRC at its meeting held on August 06, 2026 owing to administrative reasons. Accordingly, the grant of 5,500 ESOPs to an eligible employee of the Company was considered as approved on August 06, 2026, instead of June 07, 2026. Further, at its meeting held on August 06, 2026, the NRC approved the grant of an additional 24,000 ESOPs. Accordingly, the total number of outstanding ESOPs as at September 30, 2026, stood at 15,70,278 ESOPs.

The Significant Beneficial Owners (SBO's) mentioned in the SHP for Quarter ended September 30, 2026, are the Senior Management Officials of the Registered Owner i.e. CAG- Tech (Mauritius) Limited. Since the Registered Owner holds 43.90% shareholding in the Company; the same percentage holding is attributed to each SBO, who collectively account for the 43.90% shareholding of the Company.
